content: Jesuzi sahac šâic manawecte ijaha manahuc sâqocne qikiŋnezo
Kristo e sahac šâic manawecte ŋoŋe ijaha eniŋte hâbi-ŋeŋic hepie huzejec. Ehuc šiŋuc mananšepieŋ, moc e sahac šâic manaekaczi sâqocnere ninikec bâfuaekac.
Eme sahacko juju dameŋ-ticne fokac sâc sasecte gie mi bapa Anuture micdâŋ sawa reŋkehuc juzejec.

Juwicnao qâpuc wiac šiŋuc ehuc jumbiŋ: Wiac gapec tâmiric ee, sasec, opâ momori âmbâŋ nânâ, bec qowi âmbâŋ nânâ, tiwâ sisiricko nânâ, nemu burec kiŋaŋ qaqajare, wiac i hâcne ewarehuc jukupie micne qawec.
Eme ši ine qâpuc jaŋe sâqocnere šâkâŋko fohapie mi qâtec-jopaeŋgopieŋte manapie moc eme mu supaic eŋareeŋgopieŋ.
Erâ jaŋe juku jukicne hâmokicne fuŋne-nâŋec bataniŋkeocte šawierâ jukac erao dâŋgie baniŋmu.
Eme fuŋne šiŋucte hâmokicne wâc Biŋebiaŋ jazakicne: Jaŋe ŋifec ŋic hata fokac irec sâcko sahaczi okacne roniŋte, â ŋifec Anuture hata fokac irec sâcko mârozi juniŋte.
Dameŋ bembeŋkekacte ââgo erâ babafic ezo
Wiac sasawa irec dameŋ bembeŋkekac. Irec ŋoŋe maŋsowa â pectâc juhuc nunumure afeckenšepieŋ.
Erâ maŋŋeŋiczi jauŋ babac ehuc junšepieŋ. Maŋjauŋhec juhuc kiŋ bebehec sâcne ezo.
Ŋoŋe mutakic tâmiric hezu hewâneŋ eec enšepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe Anutuzi miti mâriri fuŋne fuŋne tahac-ŋopawec, i ŋicne ŋicne foŋarekac sâc aimuŋ bajuhuc bâmec babac â dodopec ehuc junšepieŋ.

Moc e miti muocmu i Anuture dâŋ jâmbâŋ ezejec, moc e gie mucnekicko baocmu ine Anutuzi tâpiri râcneme sâc bazejec. Ŋoŋe iŋuc epie Anuture huriri qâreŋ i Jesu Kristore erâ ŋoŋerao fua tâcnezejec. Eri tatamac â tâpiri i erao foweczi fohuc juocmu sanaŋ. Jâmbomac.
Jesure erâ šâic manahuc bubiaŋ bâfuazo
Jorocfâc-nane, ŋoŋerao hâbi qaqazure wiac micne momori fuawec fokac, eme ŋoŋe wiac šâŋe furu fua-nârekac muhuc bipic tatara mi enšepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe Kristore erâ šâic fâro manahuc sâc bubiaŋ bâfuanšepieŋ, eme juku eri tatamac-ticne fua tâcneme iŋuc jaha bubiaŋ sâko manahuc šeri bari eniŋmu.
Ŋoŋe Kristo šâŋe biŋe-ticnere musoc qâsoriŋ-ŋopapie manapie šerine ezejec. Wiac i eŋarepie tatamacte maqâreŋ, Anuture Mâro hâcne, ŋoŋerao waha juocmu.
Ŋoŋeraonec moczi šikare me fiucte me sindaŋte me penaroŋte šika kâpâcwâru faio mi fezejec.
Á moc e Kristoŋic jukacte šika kâpâcwâru ecnepie ine irec maname mimi busâqochec mi ezejec. E šâŋe i bajuhuc Anuture mumuteŋ bâfuazejec.

Manaŋgopieŋ, Anutu e fuŋne babataniŋ gie-ticne ŋicfâc-ticne nâŋâcnao fuŋkerâ baocte dameŋne maickekac hâcne. Nâŋâcnao qanaŋ fuŋkerâ baraku Biŋebiaŋ-ticne qikiŋneeŋgopieŋ jaŋerao batarame sâc weniŋucne fuaocmu?
Â

content.text: “Ŋic tiŋne e okac dameŋko bipic tatara ecnehame
miti qiqikiŋ â sâqocne bapa e wenac eocmu!”

content: Eme irec Anutuzi maname sâckeha fific guguriŋ faio feniŋmu jaŋe maŋ qâqâtâc-jeŋic i bâbâfua mume sasanaŋ erao râehuc eehâmo gie banšepieŋ.
